(Japanese: '''ポケットモンスターB・W グッドパートナーズ''' ''Pocket Monsters BW: Good Partners'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] authored by Kyouichi Shichigatsu and illustrated by Chiyo Kenmotsu. The manga is based on the games {{game|Black and White|s}}.

==Publications==
The entire series was collected in a single volume.
